cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 国际台的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Hello, I'm Oliver Conway.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是奥利弗·康韦。

cues.en: We're recording this at 15:00 GMT on Friday, the 7th of August.
cues.zh: 我们录制节目时是格林尼治标准时间 8 月 7 日星期五 15 点。

cues.en: A teenager in Thailand has shot dead seven people, including teachers at his school, before killing himself.
cues.zh: 泰国一名少年开枪打死包括本校教师在内的七人，随后自杀。

cues.en: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign a NATO-style defense agreement.
cues.zh: 沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和巴基斯坦签署一项北约式防务协议。

cues.en: And as the Ebola outbreak in Congo hits 4,000 cases, health experts say local communities must play a greater role.
cues.zh: 刚果的埃博拉疫情病例达到 4,000 例，卫生专家称当地社区必须发挥更大作用。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, a row in London over plans to encourage drinkers not to stand in pubs.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将报道，伦敦一项鼓励酒客不要站着喝酒的计划引发争议。

cues.en: Sometimes there's like a bit of a buzz about it, isn't there, like pub culture, I suppose, of mingling and, yeah, enjoying it and having fun.
cues.zh: 有时候现场就是会有点热闹的气氛，对吧？我想，这就是酒吧文化：大家彼此交流，尽情享受、玩得开心。

cues.en: If you come to a pub and all the tables are full, you'd probably just be like, no, not going to bother.
cues.zh: 如果你来到酒吧，发现所有桌子都坐满了，你很可能会想：算了，不费这个劲了。

cues.en: And the giant lizard of Lombardy.
cues.zh: 还有伦巴第的巨型蜥蜴。

cues.en: A school shooting in Thailand has left seven people dead and 13 people in hospital.
cues.zh: 泰国发生一起校园枪击事件，造成七人死亡、13 人住院。

cues.en: It comes after a string of high-profile attacks there in recent years, but has shocked the nation nonetheless.
cues.zh: 近年来当地曾发生一连串备受关注的袭击事件，但此次事件仍然震惊全国。

cues.en: The gunman was a 14-year-old pupil, and the school is part of a prestigious network which has educated royalty and prime ministers alike.
cues.zh: 枪手是一名 14 岁学生；这所学校隶属一个享有盛誉的教育体系，曾培养王室成员和多位总理。

cues.en: Police say the boy killed his grandparents before opening fire at the school and then killing himself.
cues.zh: 警方称，这名男孩先杀害祖父母，随后到学校开枪并自杀。

cues.en: This footage was recorded on a mobile phone by a student in one of the classrooms.
cues.zh: 这段画面由一间教室内的学生用手机拍摄。

cues.en: Pupils in their blue uniforms crouched on the floor underneath their desks, trying to stay as quiet as possible.
cues.zh: 身穿蓝色校服的学生蹲伏在课桌下的地板上，尽量不发出声音。

cues.en: Later, these students spoke about what they saw.
cues.zh: 随后，这些学生讲述了他们的所见。

cues.en: I was working in the room when I heard a gunshot, followed by several more continuously.
cues.zh: 我当时正在房间里做事，突然听到一声枪响，接着又连续响了好几枪。

cues.en: At first, I thought somebody was playing with a gun, so I called my friends to hide inside the room.
cues.zh: 起初我以为有人在玩枪，于是叫朋友们躲进房间里。

cues.en: He first opened fire underneath building five, then went up the building shooting students as he went.
cues.zh: 他先在五号楼下开枪，随后一边上楼，一边向沿途的学生射击。

cues.en: After that, he went up to another building, building four, and shot at every room. I don't know why.
cues.zh: 之后，他又上了另一栋楼，也就是四号楼，朝每个房间开枪。我不知道为什么。

cues.en: One of my friends got shot.
cues.zh: 我的一名朋友中枪了。

cues.en: He walked up to the door and just fired.
cues.zh: 他走到门口，直接开了枪。

cues.en: I don't know the shooter, but he seems to be a student with special needs.
cues.zh: 我不认识枪手，但他似乎是一名有特殊需要的学生。

cues.en: The Thai Prime Minister, Anutin Charnvirakul, said a friend of the gunman had told police the boy had been under great stress.
cues.zh: 泰国总理阿努廷·参威拉军表示，枪手的一名朋友告诉警方，这名男孩一直承受着巨大压力。

cues.en: This is violence, but it is not caused by criminals.
cues.zh: 这是一起暴力事件，但并非罪犯所为。

cues.en: It is caused by an individual who carried pressures and tensions.
cues.zh: 这是一个背负压力和紧张情绪的人所造成的。

cues.en: This really has nothing to do with security measures in the school.
cues.zh: 这确实与学校的安保措施无关。

cues.en: The gun is a registered one. It is kept in the house.
cues.zh: 这把枪登记在册，平时存放在家中。

cues.en: We don't know how this child got access to the gun.
cues.zh: 我们不知道这个孩子是如何拿到枪的。

cues.en: He intentionally came to school today to commit this unfortunate case.
cues.zh: 他今天是有意来到学校制造这起不幸事件的。

cues.en: Our Southeast Asia correspondent, Jonathan Head, gave me this update from the school north of Bangkok.
cues.zh: 本台东南亚事务记者乔纳森·黑德从曼谷以北的这所学校带来了最新情况。

cues.en: Well, it's the end of the day here, Oliver, but it's pretty quiet now.
cues.zh: 奥利弗，这里一天将近结束，现在已经相当安静了。

cues.en: All the ambulances, the police officers, paramedics and, of course, family members
cues.zh: 所有救护车、警察、医护人员，当然还有遇难者家属

cues.en: who came down during the day after the shooting, which started at 10:00 in the morning, have now gone.
cues.zh: 这些人在上午 10 点开始的枪击发生后陆续赶来，现在都已经离开。

cues.en: But of course there are a number of the victims, well over 20 people who were injured.
cues.zh: 不过当然还有不少伤者，受伤人数远超 20 人。

cues.en: We think between 20 and 30, but some of those victims are in critical condition in hospital.
cues.zh: 我们认为有 20 至 30 人受伤，其中一些伤者正在医院接受救治，情况危急。

cues.en: So there's a lot of concern about them.
cues.zh: 因此，人们非常担心他们的状况。

cues.en: And it's now down to the police to investigate a number of angles as to what actually happened here.
cues.zh: 现在要由警方从多个角度调查这里究竟发生了什么。

cues.en: This is a 14-year-old pupil at the school who teachers say had shown no behavioral issues before, was a good student.
cues.zh: 这是该校一名 14 岁学生，教师称他此前没有表现出行为问题，是个好学生。

cues.en: The Prime Minister here has referred to the fact that he might have been under some stress or some pressure from his grandparents.
cues.zh: 这里的总理提到，他可能承受着一些压力，或是来自祖父母的压力。

cues.en: And, of course, we know he shot his grandparents before he came down to the school.
cues.zh: 当然，我们知道他来到学校前曾开枪射击祖父母。

cues.en: Very vivid accounts from some of the students here describing, you know, hunkering down under their desks
cues.zh: 这里一些学生的讲述非常生动，他们描述了自己如何躲在课桌下面，

cues.en: as he went systematically from classroom to classroom, firing multiple shots into each of them.
cues.zh: 而他则有条不紊地从一间教室走到另一间，朝每间教室连开数枪。

cues.en: And the police have said they're quite surprised at how lethal he was, how accurate he appears to be—have been—with the gun.
cues.zh: 警方称，他们很惊讶他的杀伤力如此之强，也惊讶于他用枪似乎如此——或者说曾经如此——精准。

cues.en: So they think he may have had some kind of firearms training.
cues.zh: 因此，他们认为他可能接受过某种枪械训练。

cues.en: So there's, you know, obviously there has to be an investigation as to how he got hold of a gun and quite a significant amount of ammunition.
cues.zh: 所以，显然必须调查他如何拿到枪支以及数量相当可观的弹药。

cues.en: He had around 30 rounds still on him at the time that he shot himself.
cues.zh: 他开枪自杀时，身上仍带着约 30 发子弹。

cues.en: It appears it may have been his grandfather's gun.
cues.zh: 看起来那可能是他祖父的枪。

cues.en: And, of course, investigations into his state of mind and what went wrong.
cues.zh: 当然，还要调查他的精神状态以及究竟出了什么问题。

cues.en: And the fact that he was able to get hold of a gun despite strict laws there underlines the issue with gun control in Thailand?
cues.zh: 尽管当地法律严格，他仍能拿到枪，这是否凸显了泰国枪支管控的问题？

cues.en: Yeah, the strict laws apply to getting a license, and they've become stricter in recent years.
cues.zh: 是的，严格的法律适用于申领持枪证，而且近年变得更加严格。

cues.en: In fact, the Prime Minister pointed out that he tightened the gun permit rules three years ago when he was interior minister.
cues.zh: 事实上，总理指出，他三年前担任内政部长时就收紧了持枪许可规定。

cues.en: This was, by all accounts, a licensed gun.
cues.zh: 从各方面来看，这是一把登记在册的枪。

cues.en: The problem in Thailand is not the rules; it's enforcement.
cues.zh: 泰国的问题不在于规定，而在于执行。

cues.en: This country is awash with guns.
cues.zh: 这个国家枪支泛滥。

cues.en: Corruption is rife in the armed forces and police as well.
cues.zh: 军队和警察系统中腐败现象也十分猖獗。

cues.en: Anybody who wants to get a gun here can get one, and an awful lot of people have them, with or without licenses.
cues.zh: 在这里，任何想弄到枪的人都能弄到，而且有枪的人非常多，无论是否持有许可。

cues.en: Jonathan Head at the scene of that shooting in Thailand.
cues.zh: 以上是乔纳森·黑德在泰国枪击现场的报道。

cues.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is now the fastest-spreading on record.
cues.zh: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情现已成为有记录以来传播最快的一次。

cues.en: Latest figures show there've been more than 4,000 cases and nearly 2,000 deaths, with infections confirmed in five provinces, including the epicenter, Ituri.
cues.zh: 最新数据显示，病例已超过 4,000 例，死亡近 2,000 人；包括疫情中心伊图里在内的五个省均已确认感染病例。

cues.en: However, the head of Africa's Disease Control and Prevention Centre, Dr. Jean Kaseya, remains optimistic, as he told the BBC about a new action plan.
cues.zh: 不过，非洲疾病控制与预防中心负责人让·卡塞亚博士仍持乐观态度。他向 BBC 介绍了一项新的行动计划。

cues.en: The new strategy that we discussed with President Tshisekedi on the 5th of August, when Dr. Tedros,
cues.zh: 我们在 8 月 5 日与齐塞克迪总统讨论了新策略，当时谭德塞博士、

cues.en: Professor Janabi and myself, coming together with a number of partners, came to suggest the new approach.
cues.zh: 贾纳比教授和我与多位合作伙伴齐聚一堂，共同提出了这种新方法。

cues.en: What is this new approach? It is to have what we call the village-centered response plan.
cues.zh: 这种新方法是什么？就是实施我们所说的“以村庄为中心的应对计划”。

cues.en: Everything now will be at village level, and that one is a great revolution because we know that we can stop this outbreak when the community is involved.
cues.zh: 现在一切都将在村一级开展，这是一次重大变革，因为我们知道，只要社区参与进来，就能阻止疫情。

cues.en: Our Global Affairs reporter, Richard Kagoe, told us more about this new village-level approach.
cues.zh: 本台全球事务记者理查德·卡戈进一步介绍了这种新的村级应对方法。

cues.en: The new response plan does involve community leaders, so you'd have leaders from various villages.
cues.zh: 新的应对计划确实让社区领袖参与其中，因此会有来自各个村庄的负责人参加。

cues.en: The thing is that the Africa Centres for Disease Control and the WHO are saying there's need to change strategy
cues.zh: 问题是，非洲疾控中心和世界卫生组织都表示，需要改变策略，

cues.en: because the response, especially from the local population, has really made the whole management of the outbreak a bit complex
cues.zh: 因为当地民众的反应尤其使整场疫情的管理变得有些复杂，

cues.en: because there has been hesitancy from local residents to report people who have symptoms of Ebola;
cues.zh: 当地居民一直不太愿意报告出现埃博拉症状的人；

cues.en: there has been skepticism just about the disease itself, and also the health workers.
cues.zh: 人们也一直对这种疾病本身以及医务人员持怀疑态度。

cues.en: So this has really proved sort of like a barrier.
cues.zh: 所以，这确实构成了某种障碍。

cues.en: The containment efforts have been really quite complicated because the local population seems not to quite coordinate with health workers.
cues.zh: 遏制疫情的工作相当复杂，因为当地民众似乎不太配合医务人员。

cues.en: And then, of course, these are the cultural practices element.
cues.zh: 当然，还有文化习俗方面的因素。

cues.en: So, like in terms of burial, how are those bodies being handled?
cues.zh: 比如在安葬方面，那些遗体是如何处理的？

cues.en: And these have been also classified as super-spreader events.
cues.zh: 这些活动也被归为超级传播事件。

cues.en: And so what they're saying is that it's important to involve community elders who understand the cultural nuances,
cues.zh: 因此，他们认为，让理解文化细微差别的社区长老参与进来非常重要，

cues.en: and people who can be used to disseminate information, who are believable.
cues.zh: 还要让那些值得信任、能够传播信息的人参与进来。

cues.en: And also part of it is to decentralize testing capacity, especially at the village level,
cues.zh: 计划的另一部分是下放检测能力，尤其要下放到村一级，

cues.en: and also making health services accessible by making sure that it is free.
cues.zh: 同时通过确保医疗服务免费，使其更容易获得。

cues.en: So that's perhaps just the highlights of this new response plan that is going to be rolled out next week, as mentioned by the Africa CDC boss.
cues.zh: 以上或许只是这项新应对计划的几个要点。正如非洲疾控中心负责人所说，该计划将于下周推出。

cues.en: Yeah, can this approach realistically bring down the number of cases?
cues.zh: 那么，这种方法现实中真能减少病例数量吗？

cues.en: If you look at the numbers, the outbreak is spreading rapidly.
cues.zh: 从数据来看，疫情正在迅速扩散。

cues.en: But I think the involvement of this would help perhaps slow down the spread of the disease itself.
cues.zh: 但我认为，这种参与或许有助于减缓疾病本身的传播。

cues.en: Because what is happening is that, especially in rural communities, a lot of them seem to be quite disengaged exactly with what's happening,
cues.zh: 因为目前的情况是，尤其在农村社区，许多人似乎与正在发生的事情相当脱节，

cues.en: especially from the regional capitals in places like Bunia and in North Kivu province, where the disease is quite prevalent.
cues.zh: 尤其是远离布尼亚等地区中心，以及疫情相当严重的北基伍省。

cues.en: So really changing the opinions and perspectives of the local population, getting their buy-in,
cues.zh: 因此，真正改变当地民众的看法和观念、争取他们的认同，

cues.en: for them to believe and even to support the health response, I think that would really be critical in terms of slowing down the response.
cues.zh: 让他们信任甚至支持卫生应对工作，我认为这对于减缓应对进程而言确实至关重要。

cues.en: Because if you look at it, experts say that it took just about 10 months for cases to hit 2,000 in the West Africa Ebola outbreak,
cues.zh: 因为专家称，西非埃博拉疫情的病例数用了大约 10 个月才达到 2,000 例，

cues.en: but this has just been barely two months for the numbers to hit more than 2,000, now exceeding 4,000 cases.
cues.zh: 但此次疫情仅仅不到两个月，病例就超过了 2,000 例，如今已突破 4,000 例。

cues.en: Richard Kagoe in Nairobi.
cues.zh: 理查德·卡戈在内罗毕报道。

cues.en: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have signed a joint defense agreement against the backdrop of the US-Israeli war with Iran.
cues.zh: 在美以对伊朗战争的背景下，沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和巴基斯坦签署了一项联合防务协议。

cues.en: The NATO-style pact was announced at a meeting in Mecca
cues.zh: 这项北约式协议是在麦加举行的一场会晤中宣布的，

cues.en: between Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and the Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.
cues.zh: 与会者包括沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼、土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安和巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫。

cues.en: So, what does it involve?
cues.zh: 那么，这项协议包括哪些内容？

cues.en: Anbarasan Ethirajan is our Global Affairs reporter.
cues.zh: 安巴拉桑·埃蒂拉詹是本台全球事务记者。

cues.en: This is significant both in terms of symbolism and substance.
cues.zh: 无论从象征意义还是实质内容来看，这都意义重大。

cues.en: The three countries are talking about collective deterrence against any possible aggression in the future.
cues.zh: 这三个国家谈的是共同威慑，以应对未来任何可能的侵略。

cues.en: Now, you have three different countries with three different capacity and capability coming together.
cues.zh: 现在，三个能力和实力各不相同的国家走到了一起。

cues.en: Saudi Arabia is one of the biggest oil producers in the world.
cues.zh: 沙特阿拉伯是世界上最大的石油生产国之一。

cues.en: It provides the financial muscle and one of the biggest weapons purchaser, and its strategic location is very key.
cues.zh: 它提供雄厚的财力，也是最大的武器购买方之一，其战略位置也非常关键。

cues.en: Turkey is the second-biggest military force in NATO, and Pakistan is a nuclear-weapon state and also has a very strong military.
cues.zh: 土耳其是北约第二大军事力量，而巴基斯坦是核武器国家，也拥有一支非常强大的军队。

cues.en: Now, one of the key thing is that an attack on any one country will be treated as an attack against all.
cues.zh: 其中一个关键点是，对任何一国的攻击都将被视为对三国全体的攻击。

cues.en: So that is a very key wording here.
cues.zh: 因此，这是这里非常关键的措辞。

cues.en: They have not given out any specifics and details of this agreement.
cues.zh: 他们尚未公布这项协议的任何具体内容和细节。

cues.en: The fact that the three Sunni Muslim countries are coming together and signing this agreement in the holy city of Mecca,
cues.zh: 这三个逊尼派穆斯林国家走到一起，在圣城麦加签署这项协议，

cues.en: calling this as Mecca Joint Declaration, Joint Defense Agreement, is quite an important message sending out to the regional powers there.
cues.zh: 并将其称为《麦加联合宣言》和联合防务协议，是向该地区各方发出的相当重要的信息。

cues.en: Yeah, and Saudi Arabia is at the moment the country most likely to become embroiled in war.
cues.zh: 是的，目前沙特阿拉伯是最有可能卷入战争的国家。

cues.en: Will we realistically see Pakistan and Turkey coming to its aid, perhaps in the fight against the Houthi rebels in Yemen?
cues.zh: 现实中，我们会看到巴基斯坦和土耳其前来援助沙特，或许协助其对抗也门胡塞武装吗？

cues.en: Now, they do have some sort of military cooperation.
cues.zh: 他们确实存在某种军事合作。

cues.en: For example, on the ongoing Saudi conflict with the Houthi rebels,
cues.zh: 例如，在沙特与胡塞武装持续的冲突中，

cues.en: Pakistan had sent thousands of troops and fighter jets, and also an air defense and advisory group is already there.
cues.zh: 巴基斯坦曾派出数千名士兵和战斗机，而且已有一个防空与顾问小组驻扎在那里。

cues.en: And there have been, what, military cooperation for several years.
cues.zh: 而且，怎么说呢，双方的军事合作已经持续了数年。

cues.en: And Saudi Arabia agreed to buy drones from Turkey in military cooperation.
cues.zh: 沙特阿拉伯也在军事合作框架下同意从土耳其购买无人机。

cues.en: Now, if it comes to, for example, Iran, Pakistan is a neighbor of Iran,
cues.zh: 但如果涉及例如伊朗的情况，巴基斯坦与伊朗接壤，

cues.en: and whether they're going to come to the aid of Saudi Arabia if Iran attacks Saudi, that is a big question,
cues.zh: 如果伊朗袭击沙特，巴基斯坦是否会前来援助沙特，这是一个大问题，

cues.en: because they didn't come in the last round of conflict,
cues.zh: 因为在上一轮冲突中，巴基斯坦并未出手；

cues.en: even though they had a mutual defense pact signed last year—that is between Saudi Arabia and Pakistan—because Pakistan has its own security compulsions.
cues.zh: 尽管沙特与巴基斯坦去年签署了共同防御条约，这是因为巴基斯坦有自身的安全考量。

cues.en: But in the long run, what Iran will do, you know, these are the two things the three countries are looking at.
cues.zh: 但从长远来看，伊朗会如何行动，你知道，这就是三国正在考虑的两个方面。

cues.en: Now, some will describe this as an Islamic NATO, where it can involve other Gulf states as well.
cues.zh: 有人会将其形容为“伊斯兰北约”，其他海湾国家也可以加入。

cues.en: What has changed in the Gulf in the past few months is that the US used to be the net security provider.
cues.zh: 过去几个月海湾地区发生的变化是，美国过去一直是净安全提供者。

cues.en: Now, all these Gulf countries—Saudi Arabia, Qatar and UAE—have seen their installations being attacked.
cues.zh: 如今，沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔和阿联酋这些海湾国家的设施都遭到了袭击。

cues.en: They're running out of weapons and missiles.
cues.zh: 它们的武器和导弹正在耗尽。

cues.en: They're not able to protect any of those strategic places.
cues.zh: 它们无力保护那些战略要地。

cues.en: Now, they are looking at other options.
cues.zh: 现在，它们正在寻找其他选择。

cues.en: See, if the US is not going to step in and protect them, who is going to be the net security provider?
cues.zh: 你看，如果美国不介入并保护它们，谁来充当净安全提供者？

cues.en: And that is why they are having this bigger, larger combined effort.
cues.zh: 这就是它们开展这一更大、更广泛联合行动的原因。

cues.en: And very briefly, what will India make of this?
cues.zh: 最后简要说一下，印度会如何看待此事？

cues.en: India has already looked at it, and then they've responded.
cues.zh: 印度已经关注了此事，也作出了回应。

cues.en: And what they are saying is that they are looking at this agreement.
cues.zh: 他们表示，正在审视这项协议。

cues.en: A brief statement was made, but they will probably respond at a later stage.
cues.zh: 印度发表了一份简短声明，但可能会在日后作出进一步回应。

cues.en: Anbarasan Ethirajan.
cues.zh: 安巴拉桑·埃蒂拉詹报道。

cues.en: When treating brain cancer, the traditional approach has been to wait four to six weeks after surgery before chemotherapy can begin.
cues.zh: 治疗脑癌时，传统做法是术后等待四至六周，再开始化疗。

cues.en: Now though, research on mice has suggested that an alternative timescale would be to carry it out either straight after the operation or between two to four days later.
cues.zh: 不过，小鼠研究表明，可以采用另一种时间安排：在手术后立即化疗，或在术后两至四天进行。

cues.en: Dr. Tom Kisby from the University of Manchester is co-lead on the study.
cues.zh: 曼彻斯特大学的汤姆·基斯比博士是这项研究的共同负责人。

cues.en: He explained the results to Johnny Diamond.
cues.zh: 他向约翰尼·戴蒙德解释了研究结果。

cues.en: One of the main problems of brain tumors, both due to their location in quite a critical organ, obviously the brain,
cues.zh: 脑肿瘤的一个主要问题，既在于它们位于一个非常关键的器官——显然就是大脑——之中，

cues.en: but also many of these are highly invasive, meaning that surgery itself can never be curative.
cues.zh: 也在于其中许多肿瘤侵袭性很强，这意味着仅靠手术永远无法治愈。

cues.en: The surgeons will always have to leave some cancer cells behind, which is exactly what we try to treat with chemotherapy.
cues.zh: 外科医生总会不得不留下一些癌细胞，而这些正是我们试图通过化疗处理的对象。

cues.en: Ah, I see. So the, the chemo is then sort of sent in to flush out what is left.
cues.zh: 啊，明白了。所以化疗随后就像是被派进去，清除剩下的癌细胞。

cues.en: You normally wait for a few weeks, but now have discovered these two windows.
cues.zh: 通常要等待几周，但现在你们发现了这两个时间窗口。

cues.en: Can, can you explain how they've been discovered?
cues.zh: 你能解释一下这两个窗口是如何被发现的吗？

cues.en: So one of the major challenges for brain tumors is that the brain is protected from the blood by a special barrier known as the blood-brain barrier.
cues.zh: 治疗脑肿瘤的一项主要挑战是，大脑与血液之间由一道特殊屏障隔开，这就是血脑屏障。

cues.en: So when we administer chemotherapies, these struggle actually to get into the brain and the site where we need them.
cues.zh: 因此，施用化疗药物时，它们实际上很难进入大脑并抵达我们需要它们发挥作用的位置。

cues.en: What we've identified, which is exactly what these windows are, is certain time periods after surgery
cues.zh: 我们发现的是手术后的某些时段，而这正是所谓的时间窗口，

cues.en: this barrier becomes more disrupted, which means this allows certain types of chemotherapies, in our case nanomedicines,
cues.zh: 此时屏障受到的破坏更加明显，这使某些类型的化疗药物——在我们的研究中是纳米药物——

cues.en: to be able to enter the brain at much higher levels than they would if we were to administer them four to six weeks after surgery.
cues.zh: 能够以远高于术后四至六周施药时的浓度进入大脑。

cues.en: Okay, so the surgery itself disrupts the blood-brain barrier and, and sort of what, opens it up for further therapy?
cues.zh: 好的，所以手术本身会破坏血脑屏障，也就是说，在某种程度上为后续治疗打开了通道？

cues.en: Exactly, yeah. So this is the two windows.
cues.zh: 完全正确。这就是两个时间窗口。

cues.en: The first one, we think, is a physical disruption of this barrier,
cues.zh: 我们认为，第一个窗口源于这道屏障受到物理破坏，

cues.en: and then there's kind of a response of the patient in the brain that seems to reopen this window a few days later.
cues.zh: 随后患者大脑中会出现某种反应，似乎会在几天后再次打开这个窗口。

cues.en: The research was done on mice, and again, daft question alert,
cues.zh: 这项研究是在小鼠身上进行的。再次提醒，这是个傻问题：

cues.en: are you sure it transfers from mice to humans?
cues.zh: 你确定研究结果能从小鼠推广到人类吗？

cues.en: So there is some indirect evidence in humans from some imaging work that's been done that these same kind of disruption of the blood-brain barrier exists,
cues.zh: 一些人体成像研究提供了间接证据，表明人类也存在这种血脑屏障受破坏的情况，

cues.en: but of course, absolutely the next step that we need to do is confirm these same windows exist in humans and can be utilized in the same way.
cues.zh: 但当然，我们下一步必须确认人类是否也存在同样的窗口，并能以相同方式加以利用。

cues.en: So you now, I mean, if you get that, that next step and you, you adopt this as a, as a new procedure,
cues.zh: 那么，我是说，如果你们完成了下一步，并将其作为一种新的治疗程序，

cues.en: you would jump in and, forgive the phrase, flood the zone whilst the blood-brain barrier is disrupted.
cues.zh: 就会趁血脑屏障受破坏时立即介入——请原谅这个说法——向该区域大量施药。

cues.en: Is there a trade-off of some shape or form in terms of safety if you ignore what was previously the recovery period?
cues.zh: 如果忽略过去所设的恢复期，在安全性方面是否会付出某种代价？

cues.en: That's a good question. So again, this is something that I think really needs to be tested in, in clinical studies.
cues.zh: 这是个好问题。所以我再强调一次，我认为这确实需要在临床研究中接受检验。

cues.en: We, we haven't seen any issues in our mice,
cues.zh: 我们在小鼠身上没有发现任何问题，

cues.en: but it could be that what we—it could very well mean that what we do administer,
cues.zh: 但这很可能意味着，对于我们所施用的药物，

cues.en: we have to be very careful that it doesn't disrupt some of those recovery and healing responses that occur in the brain.
cues.zh: 我们必须非常谨慎，确保它不会干扰大脑中的某些恢复和愈合反应。

cues.en: Tom Kisby talking to Johnny Diamond.
cues.zh: 以上是汤姆·基斯比接受约翰尼·戴蒙德采访。

cues.en: Residents in the rural Italian town of Montichiari are used to sharing their neighborhood with the likes of foxes, hedgehogs and badgers.
cues.zh: 意大利乡村小镇蒙蒂基亚里的居民早已习惯与狐狸、刺猬和獾等动物为邻。

cues.en: But they have been warned to look out for a more fearsome visitor: a giant lizard with razor-sharp teeth and claws. Chantal Hartle explains.
cues.zh: 但他们接到警告，要提防一位更可怕的来客：一只有着锋利牙齿和爪子的巨型蜥蜴。尚塔尔·哈特尔为我们讲述。

cues.en: This tree-climbing lizard is just over one and a half meters long, dark green in color with yellow spots and big curved teeth.
cues.zh: 这种会爬树的蜥蜴体长略超一米半，呈深绿色，带有黄色斑点和弯曲的大牙齿。

cues.en: The Papuan monitor lizard, also known as a crocodile monitor, looks similar to its relative, the Komodo dragon, and as its name suggests, it is native to Papua New Guinea.
cues.zh: 巴布亚巨蜥又称鳄鱼巨蜥，外形与近亲科莫多巨蜥相似；顾名思义，它原产于巴布亚新几内亚。

cues.en: So how it ended up in the countryside in northern Italy is a mystery.
cues.zh: 因此，它究竟如何出现在意大利北部乡间，仍是一个谜。

cues.en: It was first spotted in July, prompting a major search operation.
cues.zh: 人们于 7 月首次发现它，由此展开了一场大规模搜寻行动。

cues.en: The mayor of Montichiari, Marco Togni, said initially he didn't believe it was true.
cues.zh: 蒙蒂基亚里市长马尔科·托尼表示，他起初不相信这是真的。

cues.en: Two more sightings have since been confirmed.
cues.zh: 此后又有两次目击得到证实。

cues.en: The authorities are attempting to track the lizard using drones with thermal cameras and night vision.
cues.zh: 当局正尝试使用配备热成像和夜视功能的无人机追踪这只蜥蜴。

cues.en: They've also set up cage traps filled with chicken to lure the reptile.
cues.zh: 他们还设置了装有鸡肉的笼式陷阱，以引诱这只爬行动物。

cues.en: The Papuan lizard typically feeds on animals such as pigs and deer.
cues.zh: 巴布亚巨蜥通常以猪和鹿等动物为食。

cues.en: It's not known to prey on humans, but is capable of inflicting a powerful venomous bite when threatened, so the town is taking no chances.
cues.zh: 目前没有它捕食人类的记录，但受到威胁时，它能造成强力的毒性咬伤，因此小镇不敢掉以轻心。

cues.en: It has banned residents from walking and cycling in the areas where the lizard was seen.
cues.zh: 当地已禁止居民在发现蜥蜴的区域步行或骑车。

cues.en: While this all might sound very alarming, some have seized the opportunity to get creative on social media.
cues.zh: 尽管这一切听起来非常吓人，但有人借此机会在社交媒体上发挥创意。

cues.en: AI-generated videos show the town's mayor as a lizard ranger, chasing the creature by a pool, flying a light aircraft and performing a song called "Beware of the Lizard."
cues.zh: AI 生成的视频把镇长描绘成“蜥蜴护林员”：在泳池边追赶蜥蜴、驾驶轻型飞机，还演唱一首名为《小心蜥蜴》的歌。

cues.en: The mayor has posted these memes to his own social media page, even suggesting the town adopts the reptile as a cultural mascot,
cues.zh: 镇长把这些梗图发到了自己的社交媒体页面上，甚至建议小镇把这只爬行动物作为文化吉祥物，

cues.en: but he also stressed that residents shouldn't overlook the seriousness of the situation, and has urged people to be vigilant.
cues.zh: 但他也强调，居民不应忽视事态的严重性，并敦促大家保持警惕。

cues.en: Chantal Hartle.
cues.zh: 尚塔尔·哈特尔报道。

cues.en: And still to come on this podcast, President Trump says that hundreds of thousands of people come to the United States every year,
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还将报道：特朗普总统称，每年有数十万人来到美国，

cues.en: claiming that they're coming on holiday, but really with the express purpose of giving birth to children who would then be able to obtain American citizenship.
cues.zh: 声称自己是来度假，实际明确目的是生下随后能够取得美国公民身份的孩子。

cues.en: Donald Trump signs two new executive orders in his latest attempt to end birthright citizenship.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普签署两项新的行政令，再次尝试终止出生公民权。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: A BBC investigation has found that Russia is seizing tens of thousands of homes across areas of Ukraine it's captured during its invasion.
cues.zh: BBC 的一项调查发现，俄罗斯正在其入侵期间占领的乌克兰地区没收数万套住宅。

cues.en: The Russian government says the scheme is designed to, quote, "integrate" the regions into the Russian system.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯政府称，该计划旨在——原话如此——将这些地区“纳入”俄罗斯体系。

cues.en: Olga Robinson led the investigation.
cues.zh: 奥尔加·罗宾逊牵头开展了这项调查。

cues.en: I asked her what exactly are the occupiers doing.
cues.zh: 我问她，占领者究竟在做什么。

cues.en: I think what's very important to understand here is that the Russian forces haven't just captured physically some flats and houses.
cues.zh: 我认为，这里非常重要的一点是，俄军不只是实际占据了一些公寓和住宅。

cues.en: What they are doing there right now is they've created a whole legal framework that allows the occupation authorities to seize properties en masse,
cues.zh: 他们目前在那里所做的，是建立起一整套法律框架，允许占领当局大规模没收房产，

cues.en: and we found more than 34,000 homes which are currently in the process of being seized, and many of them belong to Ukrainians who have fled the fighting.
cues.zh: 我们发现，目前有超过 34,000 套住宅正被没收，其中许多属于逃离战火的乌克兰人。

cues.en: And it works like this:
cues.zh: 具体运作方式如下：

cues.en: Properties are declared ownerless, even though they do have legal owners in Ukraine, and then they are transferred to local authorities,
cues.zh: 房产会被宣布为无主财产，尽管它们在乌克兰确有合法所有者，随后这些房产被移交给地方当局，

cues.en: and from there they could be allocated to Russian passport holders only into ownership. And the practice is not just some local scheme in the occupied territories.
cues.zh: 之后，它们可以仅以所有权形式分配给持俄罗斯护照者。这种做法并非占领区内的某项地方计划。

cues.en: It's been endorsed by Russian President Vladimir Putin, who signed a law late last year formalizing the scheme.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京已为此背书；他于去年年底签署了一项法律，使该计划正式化。

cues.en: Now, of course, Russia claims this land that it's invaded as its own.
cues.zh: 当然，俄罗斯声称其入侵的这些土地属于俄罗斯。

cues.en: What's it said about this particular case?
cues.zh: 对于这一具体案例，俄罗斯方面作何回应？

cues.en: Well, in this particular case, the Russian government told us that the scheme is part of its legal framework
cues.zh: 俄罗斯政府告诉我们，在这一案例中，该计划是其法律框架的一部分，

cues.en: to reintegrate this, as they call it, "reunited regions" into the Russian system.
cues.zh: 旨在将他们所谓的“重新统一地区”重新纳入俄罗斯体系。

cues.en: And they also told us that the scheme manages properties whose owners cannot be identified or contacted, while providing for compensation should lawful owners come forward.
cues.zh: 他们还称，该计划负责处置无法确认或联系到所有者的房产；如果合法所有者现身，则设有补偿安排。

cues.en: But then experts we spoke to say it seems to be part of a much wider effort to Russify the area—areas of occupied Ukraine,
cues.zh: 但接受我们采访的专家表示，这似乎是一项更广泛行动的一部分，旨在将乌克兰被占领地区俄罗斯化，

cues.en: and to make it much harder for Ukrainians to reintegrate these areas in future, should they retake the territory at some point.
cues.zh: 并让乌克兰日后即使重新夺回领土，也更难将这些地区重新整合。

cues.en: Yeah, realistically, what can the homeowners do, if anything?
cues.zh: 那么现实中，这些房主能做些什么吗？

cues.en: Well, Ukrainians we spoke to say once their property appears on any of the ownerless lists, it feels it's almost pretty much done deal; it's gone.
cues.zh: 接受我们采访的乌克兰人称，一旦房产出现在任何一份无主财产名单上，几乎就像已成定局：房子没了。

cues.en: That's because to try and get their properties back, Ukrainians are required to obtain a Russian passport and return to occupied Ukraine in person.
cues.zh: 因为乌克兰人若想取回房产，必须取得俄罗斯护照，并亲自返回被占领的乌克兰地区。

cues.en: That means also going through grueling security checks at the Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport, which are known as filtration, and they have to do all of that within just 30 days.
cues.zh: 这还意味着要在莫斯科谢列梅捷沃机场接受严苛的安全检查，也就是所谓的“甄别”，并且必须在短短 30 天内完成这一切。

cues.en: So Ukrainians we spoke to say they feel it's neither safe nor possible for them to return to their homes.
cues.zh: 因此，接受采访的乌克兰人表示，他们认为返回家园既不安全，也不可行。

cues.en: So a few of them did come across as almost resigned to the idea that their homes are all but lost.
cues.zh: 所以，其中几人似乎几乎已经接受了家园基本无法挽回的现实。

cues.en: Olga Robinson. And we have more from Olga, including her own personal insight into being half Ukrainian and half Russian, on our YouTube channel.
cues.zh: 以上是奥尔加·罗宾逊。我们的 YouTube 频道还有更多来自奥尔加的内容，其中包括她作为乌克兰与俄罗斯混血者的个人见解。

cues.en: Search for BBC News on YouTube, and you'll find the Global News Podcast in the Podcasts section.
cues.zh: 在 YouTube 搜索 BBC News，即可在“播客”栏目找到《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Staying with the war in Ukraine, and the highest court in Sweden has ruled that a cargo ship seized in the Baltic Sea earlier this year can be handed over to Kyiv.
cues.zh: 继续关注乌克兰战争。瑞典最高法院裁定，今年早些时候在波罗的海被扣押的一艘货船可移交给基辅。

cues.en: The Caffa was sailing under a false flag of Guinea, but it's believed to have belonged to Russia's shadow fleet, which Moscow uses to avoid Western sanctions.
cues.zh: “卡法号”冒用几内亚船旗航行，但据信属于俄罗斯的“影子舰队”；莫斯科利用这支舰队规避西方制裁。

cues.en: Ukraine suspected it was illegally transporting grain stolen from territory occupied by Russia.
cues.zh: 乌克兰怀疑该船非法运输从俄占区掠夺的粮食。

cues.en: Ben Wright heard more from Stephanie Baker at Bloomberg News, who's written extensively about Russia's shadow fleet.
cues.zh: 本·赖特采访了彭博新闻社的斯蒂芬妮·贝克；她曾广泛报道俄罗斯影子舰队。

cues.en: It is significant because I believe this is the first time a foreign court has approved transferring a vessel to Ukraine,
cues.zh: 此事意义重大，因为我认为，这是外国法院首次批准将一艘船移交给乌克兰，

cues.en: at the request of Ukrainian prosecutors, who say that it is part of a war crimes investigation into the alleged theft of grain from occupied Crimea.
cues.zh: 这是应乌克兰检察官请求作出的；他们称，此举属于针对从被占领的克里米亚涉嫌盗取粮食的战争罪调查。

cues.en: So there have been probably a dozen instances of European authorities either boarding or detaining a ship.
cues.zh: 欧洲当局登船检查或扣押船只的案例大概已有十几起。

cues.en: But Sweden has been particularly active this year and has detained five ships.
cues.zh: 但瑞典今年尤其积极，已经扣押了五艘船。

cues.en: And this one they have decided to hand over to the Ukrainians as part of this war crimes investigation.
cues.zh: 而这艘船，瑞典决定作为战争罪调查的一部分移交给乌克兰方面。

cues.en: And the Ukrainians are saying this is a precedent-setting case, implying that perhaps more of these actions could come in the near future.
cues.zh: 乌克兰方面称这是一起开创先例的案件，暗示近期可能出现更多类似行动。

cues.en: Because this was carrying grain, but most of the shadow fleet vessels that are boarded tend to carry oil, don't they?
cues.zh: 因为这艘船运的是粮食，而被登船检查的影子舰队船只大多运油，对吧？

cues.en: That's right. And that's another reason why this is significant and, and different.
cues.zh: 没错。这也是此案意义重大且与众不同的另一个原因。

cues.en: Most of the shadow fleet, about 600 vessels that have been sanctioned by the UK and Europe, are carrying oil on behalf of Russia.
cues.zh: 影子舰队的大多数船只——约 600 艘受到英国和欧洲制裁的船只——都在为俄罗斯运输石油。

cues.en: And so this is a first in terms of seizing a cargo ship that was allegedly transporting grain from occupied Crimea to Syria,
cues.zh: 因此，扣押一艘涉嫌将粮食从被占领的克里米亚运往叙利亚的货船，尚属首次，

cues.en: and was sailing from Morocco to St. Petersburg.
cues.zh: 该船当时正从摩洛哥驶往圣彼得堡。

cues.en: So this is a very different case, but the ship was operating in similar ways to shadow fleet ships.
cues.zh: 所以这是一起非常不同的案件，但该船的运作方式与影子舰队船只相似。

cues.en: They initially detained it because Swedish authorities believed it had a false flag, and that gave it grounds to board the ship and investigate.
cues.zh: 瑞典当局起初扣押该船，是因为怀疑它冒用船旗；这为登船调查提供了依据。

cues.en: But this is a huge problem because there are hundreds of vessels, many of them carrying sanctioned Russian oil, Iranian oil, and very few have been stopped.
cues.zh: 但这是一个巨大问题，因为此类船只有数百艘，其中许多运输受制裁的俄罗斯石油和伊朗石油，却极少被拦截。

cues.en: And many are carrying false flags or registering in jurisdictions that don't do checks on the underlying documentation or insurance.
cues.zh: 许多船只冒用船旗，或在不核查基础文件和保险的司法管辖区登记。

cues.en: And European authorities have allowed these ships to transit European waters without checks and have not been aggressively checking them.
cues.zh: 欧洲当局允许这些船只未经检查通过欧洲水域，也没有积极对其开展核查。

cues.en: Now, Sweden changed its rules last year to give its coast guard more authority to do checks, stop vessels and check for, you know, documentation.
cues.zh: 瑞典去年修改规定，赋予海岸警卫队更大权限，可开展检查、拦停船只，并核查相关文件，

cues.en: potential forged documentation and the like.
cues.zh: 包括可能伪造的文件等。

cues.en: And that has led to Sweden really stepping up and being one of the most active countries in Europe to, to try to police the shadow fleet.
cues.zh: 这促使瑞典显著加大行动力度，成为欧洲最积极尝试监管影子舰队的国家之一。

cues.en: But other countries, the UK, France, have boarded ships in the past, but they could be much more aggressive in terms of policing their waters.
cues.zh: 英国、法国等其他国家过去也曾登船检查，但在监管本国水域方面本可以采取更积极的行动。

cues.en: Stephanie Baker from Bloomberg News.
cues.zh: 以上是彭博新闻社的斯蒂芬妮·贝克。

cues.en: Weeks after the US Supreme Court overruled his last attempt to eliminate birthright citizenship, President Trump is trying again.
cues.zh: 美国最高法院否决特朗普上一次取消出生公民权的尝试数周后，他再次采取行动。

cues.en: On Thursday, he signed two executive orders aimed at curbing the right for anyone born in the USA to automatically become an American citizen.
cues.zh: 周四，他签署两项行政令，旨在限制任何在美国出生者自动成为美国公民的权利。

cues.en: One man came in with a family, had said, said he had 56 children.
cues.zh: 有一个人带着家人进来，曾说——说自己有 56 个孩子。

cues.en: Another one came in, they said they had 98 children.
cues.zh: 另一个人进来时，他们说自己有 98 个孩子。

cues.en: This was not what it was for.
cues.zh: 这并不是这项权利的本意。

cues.en: This was meant for the babies of slaves.
cues.zh: 这原本是为奴隶的孩子设立的。

cues.en: It was, it was right after, one week or two weeks after the Civil War ended.
cues.zh: 那是在内战结束后不久，就在一两周之后。

cues.en: This wasn't for wealthy multimillionaires, billionaires coming in and bringing 15, 20, 30 children along with them.
cues.zh: 这并不是为富有的千万富翁、亿万富翁而设，让他们入境时带上 15 个、20 个、30 个孩子。

cues.en: It's become a big business, and we're ending that business.
cues.zh: 这已经成了一门大生意，而我们要终结这门生意。

cues.en: Our North America editor, Sarah Smith, looks at the President's new tactics.
cues.zh: 本台北美事务编辑莎拉·史密斯分析了总统的新策略。

cues.en: He's trying to use a, a different method to achieve some of the same result here,
cues.zh: 他正试图采用另一种方法，取得部分相同的结果，

cues.en: because the initial executive order that he signed on his very first day in office was aimed at
cues.zh: 因为他上任第一天签署的最初行政令，目的在于

cues.en: getting rid of automatic birthright citizenship for children who were born of parents who were either undocumented migrants in America or were only in the country temporarily.
cues.zh: 取消一部分儿童自动获得的出生公民权：他们的父母要么是美国境内的无证移民，要么只是临时身处美国。

cues.en: But that's what the Supreme Court justices ruled was unconstitutional.
cues.zh: 但最高法院大法官裁定，这种做法违反宪法。

cues.en: Now, this new order is, is a different route to try and get some of the same result.
cues.zh: 如今，这项新行政令是实现部分相同结果的另一条路径。

cues.en: This order outlaws what he's calling birthright tourism.
cues.zh: 这项行政令将他所谓的“出生公民权旅游”列为非法。

cues.en: President Trump says that hundreds of thousands of people come to the United States every year, claiming that they're coming on holiday,
cues.zh: 特朗普总统称，每年有数十万人来到美国，声称自己是来度假，

cues.en: but really with the express purpose of giving birth to children who would then be able to obtain American citizenship.
cues.zh: 但实际明确目的是生下随后能够取得美国公民身份的孩子。

cues.en: Well, he says that that is fraud, and they would have fraudulently filled in visa forms.
cues.zh: 他说，这属于欺诈，而这些人会被视为以欺诈方式填写了签证表格。

cues.en: And therefore, they could be denied the citizenship for their children under immigration law.
cues.zh: 因此，根据移民法，他们的孩子可能会被拒绝授予公民身份。

cues.en: Now, it's a different way to try and work around the Supreme Court's initial ruling,
cues.zh: 这是试图绕过最高法院最初裁决的另一种方式，

cues.en: but this is bound to be challenged in court itself, possibly all the way up to the Supreme Court.
cues.zh: 但它必然会在法庭上受到挑战，案件甚至可能一路上诉至最高法院。

cues.en: So it's not clear Donald Trump will get this time what it is that he wants.
cues.zh: 因此，唐纳德·特朗普这次能否如愿，尚不清楚。

cues.en: Sarah Smith in Washington.
cues.zh: 莎拉·史密斯在华盛顿报道。

cues.en: Now, if you've ever passed a pub in London during the summertime, you'll probably have noticed crowds of people milling around outside, drinking.
cues.zh: 如果你曾在夏天经过伦敦的一家酒吧，可能会注意到成群的人在外面边闲逛边喝酒。

cues.en: Inside, there may well be crowds of people standing at the bar.
cues.zh: 酒吧里面也很可能挤满站在吧台旁的人。

cues.en: But one local authority in the city is considering guidance that could see less of this so-called vertical drinking.
cues.zh: 但伦敦一个地方政府正在考虑制定指导意见，可能减少这种所谓的“站立饮酒”。

cues.en: Westminster City Council says having more seating in pubs could discourage excessive drunkenness.
cues.zh: 威斯敏斯特市议会称，酒吧增加座位可能有助于遏制过度醉酒。

cues.en: The government has now weighed in, saying pubs full of people is not a public nuisance; it is British life.
cues.zh: 英国政府现已介入，称酒吧里人头攒动并非扰民，而是英国生活。

cues.en: Here's what some pub-goers here in London think.
cues.zh: 来听听伦敦一些酒客的看法。

cues.en: I mean, it depends on the place.
cues.zh: 我是说，这要看具体场所。

cues.en: Sometimes you go to some bars and you're stood there for ages and you don't get served, and you get annoyed.
cues.zh: 有时候你去酒吧，站在那里等了很久却没人服务，确实会感到恼火。

cues.en: I guess when you're at a table, you can do like table service, you know, or scan a QR code, things like that.
cues.zh: 我想，坐在桌边时可以接受桌边服务，你知道，或者扫二维码之类的。

cues.en: So I guess there's an argument for sitting down is better.
cues.zh: 所以我想，确实有理由认为坐着更好。

cues.en: But I don't know, sometimes there's like a bit of a buzz about it, isn't there?
cues.zh: 但我也说不准，有时候现场就是会有点热闹的气氛，对吧？

cues.en: Like pub culture, I suppose, of mingling and, yeah, enjoying it and having fun.
cues.zh: 我想，这就是酒吧文化：大家彼此交流，尽情享受、玩得开心。

cues.en: The businesses will struggle, because if you come to a pub and all the tables are full,
cues.zh: 酒吧生意会陷入困境，因为如果你进店后发现桌子全满了，

cues.en: whereas before, or now, you would sort of like squidge in and sort of get a little pint with your mate
cues.zh: 而以前或者现在，你还能勉强挤进去，和朋友喝上一小杯，

cues.en: and sort of have a little chat and then go to the train or whatever and be on your merry way,
cues.zh: 聊上一会儿，再去赶火车或做别的事，然后轻松离开；

cues.en: you'd probably just be like, "No, not going to bother." You have more chats with people at the bar. Sometimes you meet people you don't know, not just your friends.
cues.zh: 现在你很可能只会想：“算了，不费这个劲了。”站在吧台边会和更多人聊天；有时你会认识陌生人，而不只是和朋友待在一起。

cues.en: I feel like that'll definitely be a massive impact if you couldn't stand up and queue at the bar.
cues.zh: 我觉得，如果不能站着在吧台前排队，肯定会产生巨大影响。

cues.en: Jonathan Lawson runs more than 100 pubs across the UK.
cues.zh: 乔纳森·劳森在英国经营着 100 多家酒吧。

cues.en: What does he make of all this?
cues.zh: 他如何看待这一切？

cues.en: When I first heard about this, it was yet another moment that I've had in this industry
cues.zh: 我刚听说此事时，又一次产生了在这个行业里常有的那种感受，

cues.en: where I've scratched my head about government, be it at a national or local level, doing things that you—really do perplex you.
cues.zh: 那就是对政府感到困惑：无论国家还是地方层面，它们有时所做的事实在令人费解。

cues.en: And once again, you've got an authority here getting involved in an issue which is not an issue.
cues.zh: 又一次，当局介入了一个根本不成问题的问题。

cues.en: Pubs are wonderful democratic things.
cues.zh: 酒吧是非常美好的民主场所。

cues.en: It's—you get to choose what you wish to do with people.
cues.zh: 也就是说，你可以选择与人们一起做什么。

cues.en: And if you look at any group of people standing in any one of our pubs at any given time,
cues.zh: 如果你在任何时候看看我们任何一家酒吧里站着的人群，

cues.en: some people will be drinking alcohol, some people won't, some people will have one drink and then go, some people will then have a few more drinks.
cues.zh: 有些人在喝酒，有些人不喝；有些人喝一杯就走，也有些人会再多喝几杯。

cues.en: The point is, you choose and you decide what to do.
cues.zh: 关键在于，你可以自行选择并决定怎么做。

cues.en: Pubs in London tend to be smaller, and therefore actually the economic model doesn't work if you're trying to encourage all of those people to sit down.
cues.zh: 伦敦的酒吧通常较小，因此如果试图让所有人都坐下，这种经营模式实际上就行不通。

cues.en: We just think a modern pub is an incredible thing now,
cues.zh: 我们只是认为，如今的现代酒吧非常了不起，

cues.en: where you might find locals drinking at the bar, you might find people in a business meeting, you might find people there for a special event or an occasion and a celebration.
cues.zh: 你可能看到当地人在吧台喝酒，看到有人举行商务会议，也可能有人为某个特别活动、场合或庆典来到这里。

cues.en: And that's a unique thing to be able to achieve within a British pub.
cues.zh: 能够在英国酒吧中实现这一点，是非常独特的。

cues.en: They're fantastic things, and actually the vast majority of customers behave completely responsibly and enjoy them,
cues.zh: 酒吧是很棒的地方，而且绝大多数顾客都表现得非常负责任，并享受其中，

cues.en: and I watch customers all day long and listen to them, and that they are fantastic, wonderful things that we should look after.
cues.zh: 我整天观察顾客、听他们交谈；酒吧是我们应该珍惜的美妙事物。

cues.en: Jonathan Lawson, manager of a British pub group.
cues.zh: 以上是英国一家酒吧集团的经理乔纳森·劳森。

cues.en: And that is all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期节目的全部内容。

cues.en: But the Global News Podcast will be back very soon.
cues.zh: 《全球新闻播客》很快会再次与您见面。

cues.zh: 本期节目由悉尼·邓登负责混音，爱丽丝·阿德利制作。

cues.en: Our editor's Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Oliver Conway.
cues.zh: 我是奥利弗·康韦。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再见。
